title: Figma Plugin Phase 9 - CSS-to-Constants Sync (Tailwind v4 Theme Alignment)
overview: Eliminate drift between theme-kumo.css @theme values and hardcoded Tailwind scales in the parser. Kumo uses Tailwind v4's CSS-based theme, which overrides default Tailwind values, but the Figma plugin's parser still uses default Tailwind scales.

context.problem: CRITICAL DRIFT DETECTED: Kumo's theme-kumo.css defines custom typography sizes (--text-sm: 13px, --text-base: 14px, --text-lg: 16px) but the Figma plugin's FONT_SIZE_SCALE uses Tailwind defaults (sm: 14, base: 16, lg: 18). This means Figma components are generated with WRONG font sizes.
context.current_state: Phase 8 tasks T1-T3 COMPLETE (test assertions hardened). However, those tests now assert INCORRECT values because the source constants themselves are wrong.
context.why_now: The font size drift is actively causing incorrect Figma components. Fixing test assertions without fixing the source values perpetuates the error.

architecture_vulnerability.layer_1: tailwind-to-figma.ts (parser) - Lines 70-78 contain FONT_SIZE_SCALE with Tailwind defaults
architecture_vulnerability.layer_2: shared.ts (fallback constants) - FONT_SIZE constant has same incorrect values
architecture_vulnerability.root_cause: Tailwind v4 moved theme values to CSS @theme directive. Neither parser nor constants read from theme-kumo.css.

files_with_fragile_assertions: Other files with similar patterns (22+ warnings) - T4 pending

primary: Fix FONT_SIZE_SCALE in tailwind-to-figma.ts to match theme-kumo.css
Fix FONT_SIZE in shared.ts to match theme-kumo.css
Add drift detection test that validates parser values against CSS theme
Ensure Figma components use correct Kumo typography (13px sm, 14px base, 16px lg)
metrics: Font size values match theme-kumo.css: 100% (currently 25% - only xs matches)
Drift detection test for CSS theme alignment: PASSING
Figma-generated components use correct typography sizes
